feature: OptiFine 1.8.9 custom sky horizon and void occlusion fix

reference.approach: Implement the rendering policy directly in the existing renderer; do not bundle Patcher or its Mixin/ASM classes.

changes: Use Patcher sky-plane bounds [-384, 448] on X/Z, independent of view distance.
Keep low-distance mesh vertex counts within the original budget; cap each plane at 676 vertices. At 16+ chunks, coordinates exactly match Patcher.
Skip the lower sky VBO and its matrix operations outright; preserve the valid display-list fallback with VBO disabled.
Omit the opaque below-horizon void box, matching the default-enabled Patcher Player Void Rendering policy.

performance_review.mesh_generation: Existing sky-buffer rebuild only; no new tick/render handlers, caches or per-frame mesh generation.
performance_review.vbo_draws_removed: One lower-plane draw per sky pass; below the horizon also remove the black-plane draw and the 20-vertex box draw.
performance_review.limits: Structural rendering-cost review and offscreen GL validation, not an in-game FPS/GPU-time benchmark. Fixed larger coverage and changed low-distance tessellation may affect fog/shader appearance; real resource packs and shader packs have not been checked in-game.

validation.geometry_test: SkyboxGeometryTest: full coverage, winding, height and vertex budgets at 0-64 chunks; shared edges; exact Patcher coordinates at 16 chunks.

recovery_audit.meaning: Recovery audit only; does not assert successful source compilation or runtime equivalence of cleaned source

validation.native_render_scope: Synthetic solid-color CustomSkyLayer in the actual renderSky path; VBO-off frames are checked for GL errors and switch safety, not absence of the retained lower display-list plane.

negative_control.result: Original RenderGlobal fails the lower-VBO null trap at RenderGlobal.java:1507; the changed packaged JAR passes.
